title: Audit review, correlation and reporting need operational evidence
remediation: The sponsor security operations lead sets review frequency, criteria for unusual activity and impact, findings recipients and repositories to correlate. Sample a dated review linking records from more than one assessed repository to findings and their reporting. Identify unmonitored sources or provider dependencies for review.

milestones.title: Collect the approved review schedule and a de-identified cross-repository analysis with findings and reporting evidence
